title: NoemaForge ToolProxy Capability Token
description: A scoped, time-bound, epoch-pinned authorization for a single tool invocation through ToolProxy. Deny-by-default: a tool call is rejected unless a valid token authorizes exactly this tool and scope, for the active contract epoch, before expiry.

token_id.description: Opaque unique id for this token (for audit/revocation).

tool.description: Exact tool name this token authorizes. Must equal the request's tool.

scope.description: Scope/namespace the token is valid for (e.g. a project, role, or resource). Must equal the request's scope.

contract_epoch.description: Contract epoch this token is pinned to. A token does not authorize calls under any other epoch.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC expiry; ToolProxy denies after this instant.

reason.description: Human-readable audit reason recorded with every authorized or denied call.

subject.description: Optional issuing role/agent identity for the audit trail.

revoked.description: If true, ToolProxy must deny regardless of expiry.

signature.description: Optional detached signature/validity marker verified by ToolProxy at call time.
